before_times: What it's for: a wedding, an event, photos, a lesson or a trial
The date and the ready-by time (when everyone must be done)
Where everyone gets ready: a home, a hotel or a venue, and the town only (for the travel fee)
How many faces, and each person's role (the bride, bridesmaids, mothers, anyone under 18)
Who wants strip lashes, and any bridal hair
Whether they want a trial before the day
after_time: Each person's name, for the schedule
A day-of contact and their mobile, if Alex won't be there first
The look: soft, glam, photo-ready; any inspiration photos (on the secure page)
A table near a window and a plug, and a chair for each artist
At the studio: what the lesson or look is for
secure_page_only: Known allergies (to a product, lash glue, latex or a fragrance) and skin conditions, each person answering for themselves on a link the booker forwards
A past reaction to makeup or lash glue
The getting-ready street address and any door or suite code
Anyone under 18: their parent's yes, and that the parent stays
May the business show photos of the makeup? Each person's own yes; a parent for anyone under 18
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult. For a wedding, the couple or someone they name; the booker answers only for themselves, and each person in the party answers their own skin and photo questions. A parent books a child and stays.

stop.words: A reaction now: the face, lips or throat swelling, or trouble breathing
stop.booking: No booking, and the artist and the owner are told. Never makeup on a reacting face.

stop.words: Makeup or lash glue in the eye with pain or a change in sight
stop.says: Rinse the eye with clean running water for 15 minutes. If you can't see or it's badly hurt, call 911 now. Otherwise see a doctor today.
stop.booking: No booking until a doctor says it's fine.

go_on.words: A rash, redness, itching or puffiness after makeup, with no danger signs
go_on.says: Take the makeup off gently with water and a mild cleanser. Don't add more. Your artist will call you.
go_on.booking: The artist calls within the hour (the owner if the artist is silent 15 minutes) and decides: a different product, a patch test, or a doctor.

go_on.words: A skin infection, cold sore, pink eye or open skin where the makeup goes, on the day
go_on.says: No makeup on that area, so it can't spread or worsen.
go_on.booking: The artist works around it or leaves that area bare; a whole face that can't be done moves with no fee.

safety_and_stop_words.always: Always on: danger to life, fire, gas, or a medical emergency gets 'call 911' first. Rosie never judges a reaction: the artist or a doctor decides.

prep: Come with clean, moisturized skin and no makeup
Wear a button-front top, so nothing goes over the face
A table by a window, a plug and a chair for each artist
Contact lenses in before your turn, not after

staff.licenses_or_certificates: Each artist's license per state, where the state licenses makeup work; a stylist's cosmetology license for hair.
staff.supervision: Students and apprentices work only under a licensed artist, where the state's rules allow.
staff.who_oks: The owner OKs every wedding quote, any stand-in lead and any face added on the day. An office manager may OK prices if the owner sets it.
staff.stand_in: At the studio: another studio artist with the skill, at the same time and price; with no reply 2 hours before, that stand-in comes, and Sam can turn this off. On location: a lead artist the owner trusts, even from outside the team, cleared for that place, offered by name; the wedding contract names the stand-in, so with no reply by 8pm the evening before, the stand-in comes and Sam calls. A full refund is always the other choice. The stand-in gets the trial's look and each person's secure notes.

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult. For a wedding, the couple or someone they name; the booker answers only for themselves, and each person in the party answers their own skin and photo questions. A parent books a child and stays.
children_and_age.minors_texts: Anyone under 18 in a party needs a parent's yes on a page the booker forwards; Rosie never texts the minor or the parent first.
children_and_age.minors_rules: A parent's yes for anyone under 18, and the parent stays; a parent's written OK where the state's rules require one.

visit.done: The lead artist texts DONE when the last face is done; the trial's look and any new products go in the artist's notes for next time.
visit.changes_at_visit: A face added on the day only if an artist is free before the ready-by time, priced from the list, with the payer's written yes. Touch-up hours the same way.

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: A switch from the state form. Where the state's rules license makeup work, it falls under a cosmetology or esthetics license (or a makeup license where the state issues one); some states exempt makeup-only work, sometimes after a short course. Hair styling is licensed nearly everywhere.
license.who: Each artist holds their own license where the state licenses people. The studio holds an establishment license where the state issues one. Work at a home, hotel or venue may need a permit or a link to a licensed studio: the state form says.
ask: The business's establishment license or registration, where the state issues one
Each artist's license number, in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
Any permit the state's form asks for work away from a licensed studio
license.insurance: Liability insurance on file, with its end date, where the state form or a venue asks. Many hotels and venues ask for a certificate naming them.
license.background: Only where the state's form asks, like for permits to work away from a studio.

never_in_a_text: Allergies, skin conditions, past reactions, patch-test results and medical notes stay on the secure page and the artist's job link, never in a text to the customer, the owner or the staff, and never through the AI. A text says only 'a note is on the page'.
